component-metadata.description:
In this metanode, the protein groups are selected based on whether or not they were detected based on proteotypic peptides or on shared peptides only. The selected set of proteins can be found in the first output port. The three remaining ports containg always the following sets for later use: port 2: PGs based on proteotypic peptides only port 3: PGs based on shared peptides only port 4: PGs based on proteotypic or shared peptides, i.e. the input table
=================
Used programs and tools and their respective licenses at the time of the metanode creation. Version numbers and the licenses might differ based on your local installation. Please inspect your local installation and contact us if you can not locate your local version and or license terms.
KNIME nodes (The KNIME nodes consists of the following GNU GPL 3.0 License. Licence terms are available here: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl.html) Python 3 (The Python consists of the following Python 3.6 License. Licence terms are available here: https://docs.python.org/3.6/license.html)
The metanode was created in KNIME 4.1.3 running inside the docker image (https://hub.docker.com/r/cfprot/knime/), tag 4.1.3a.
